out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: PIC Duties, Train Employees on Cleaning and Sanitizing
violations.observation: PIC demonstrated the facility’s procedures for cleaning and sanitizing. Upon observation of procedures, dishes are washed with hot, soapy water twice and left to air dry.
violations.corrective_action: The Person in Charge or certified food manager shall train his/her employees to properly sanitize all equipment, utensils, and surfaces after being cleaned using either an approved sanitizer at the adequate concentration or heat sanitization at the proper temperature to destroy pathogenic bacteria. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC HOW TO SANITIZE PROPERLY. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO SET UP THE 3 COMPARTMENT SINK TO WASH, RINSE, AND SANITIZE WITH QUATERNARY AMMONIA SOLUTION. SOAK IN SANITIZER FOR 30-60 SECONDS BEFORE ALLOW TO AIR DRY. FEELINGS GIFT SHOP (Inspection Date: 05/20/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The establishment has not posted the permit to operate in a conspicuous location.
violations.corrective_action: A valid permit shall be posted in every food establishment in a conspicuous place in the public view. Food establishment permits are issued for a calendar year and expire on December 31 regardless of the month of issue. PIC POSTED THE 2026 PERMIT.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information in a red folder labeled 'Employee Health Policy.' NO WRITTEN EMPLOYEE HEALTH POLICY WAS OBSERVED ON SITE.
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. EHS EMAILED PIC WITH AN ELECTRONIC COPY OF THE FAIRFAX COUNTY EMPLOYEE ILLNESS AGREEMENT. HAVE ALL EMPLOYEES READ AND SIGN A COPY. RETAIN ON SITE FOR FUTURE INSPECTIONS.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. EHS PROVIDED PIC WITH FAIRFAX COUNTY’S VOMIT AND DIARRHEA CLEAN UP PROCEDURES. RETAIN ON SITE FOR FUTURE INSPECTIONS.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The hot water at the hand sink in the front retail area was observed at 71f
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. ENSURE HOT WATER AT THE HAND SINK REACHES 100f. CORRECT BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION. PIC TURNED ON THE HOT WATER HEATER. HOT WATER WAS NOW OBSERVED AT 106f

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: A hand sign was not posted at the hand sink in the front retail area
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. EHS PROVIDED PIC WITH A HAND SIGN TO POST AT THIS HAND SINK.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) cheese danish was observed at 68f
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED THE CHEESE DANISH. KEEP CHEESE DANISHES IN THE COOLER MOVING FORWARD.

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. PURCHASE A FOOD PROBE THERMOMETER BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device Used to Check Sanitizer Conc
violations.observation: A quaternary ammonia test kit was not observed on site.
violations.corrective_action: The operator shall be monitoring the concentration of the sanitizing solution using a test kit or other device. PURCHASE A QUATERNARY AMMONIA TEST KIT. SEND INVOICE TO EHS BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Manual Heat Sanitization, Water Temperature
violations.observation: Hot water at the 3 compartment sink was observed at 71f
violations.corrective_action: If hot water is used for sanitization in manual warewashing operations, the sanitizing compartment of the sink shall be designed with an integral heating device that is capable of maintaining water at a temperature not less than 171F. PIC TURNED ON THE HOT WATER HEATER. HOT WATER WAS OBSERVED AT 111f.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Mops Allowed to Air Dry
violations.observation: Observed mop being stored in dirty mop water
violations.corrective_action: Store mops in a position that allows them to air dry without soiling walls, equipment, or supplies. INVERT MOP TO ALLOW TO AIR DRY.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed no handwashing sign at the hand sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. EHS GAVE PIC A HAND WASHING SIGN. PLEASE POST THE HANDWASHING SIGN.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: 1) 2DR under counter cooler; 2) 2DR Pepsi cooler; 3) 1DR Pepsi cooler
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO PLACE AMBIENT AIR THERMOMETERS IN THE THREE COOLERS. THIS IS A REPEAT VIOLATION.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Observed food being stored directly on the floor of the both dry storage rooms.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC TO ELEVATE ALL FOOD AND BEVERAGES OFF OF THE FLOOR. ADDITIONAL ORGANIZATION IS REQUIRED. USE NSF APPROVED STORAGE SHELVES OR DUNNAGE RACKS. DO NOT USE WOODEN PALLETS. THIS IS A REPEAT VIOLATION.
